_comment: Maps every point of TODO.md « To confirm on the Mac » to the field report evidence that decides it. Each unchecked TODO line carries <!-- field-point: <id> --> on its first line. A check names a field run step of data/field_run.json (optionally the report steps that decide it, and a max for a count or duration) or a collector step of steps.txt. A point with no check states why a field report cannot test it (not_testable), and a point with a remainder no run can test says so too. tools/dev/field-todo-summary.py turns a report into one verdict per point (docs/tooling/macos-field-report-coverage.md); tests/unit/infra/field_run/test_field_todo_coverage.lua fails when a TODO line has no entry or an entry names a missing step.
